open_questions: Which exact Google Cloud IAM roles or permissions does an administrator need to enable both APIs and configure Google Auth Platform? Google's public Sheets MCP page does not specify them.

Does Google expose OAuth protected-resource metadata at another well-known URL that would allow Use Discovered? A public request to https://sheetsmcp.googleapis.com/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource did not return metadata, and the provider documentation only describes manually registered OAuth clients.

blockers.where: Opening prose: “Sign in to the Developer Preview page and the Google Cloud console with the account that manages this project.”
blockers.problem: The Research Dossier does not establish that the Google Workspace account used for Developer Preview must be the same account that manages the Google Cloud project.
blockers.suggestion: Describe the two access requirements separately without asserting that one account must satisfy both.

blockers.problem: The opening omits the Dossier's permission fact that the MCP Server inherits the connected Google user's permissions and data-governance controls.
blockers.suggestion: Add a concise opening statement that users must connect an intended Google account whose existing permissions provide the required Sheets access.

blockers.problem: The Dossier records only a further-reading URL instead of transcluding the canonical closing sentence required by doctrine/speakeasy-setup.md.
blockers.suggestion: Replace the abbreviated further-reading note with the canonical setup-only closing sentence using the Google Sheets MCP documentation URL, then rerender speakeasy.md from it.

blockers.problem: Metadata omits the Dossier's protected-resource metadata probe used to support the manual OAuth configuration decision.
blockers.suggestion: Add a provenance record for https://sheetsmcp.googleapis.com/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource with the run's observed_at timestamp.

blockers.problem: The application requires Google Cloud project information before readers without a project are told how to create one.
blockers.suggestion: Move the new-project path before application submission, then direct the reader back to the Developer Preview form with the created project selected.

blockers.where: #configure-oauth-consent, “If Google Auth Platform not configured yet appears”
blockers.problem: Readers whose Google Auth Platform is already configured are sent into first-time setup controls such as Get Started and Next that will not appear.
blockers.suggestion: Wrap the first-time configuration steps in the unconfigured-state condition and explicitly tell readers with an existing configuration to continue at Add the Google Sheets scopes.

nits.problem: The Dossier does not record the application form's field and submission-control labels or state that Google's public documentation omits them.
nits.suggestion: Research the published form labels and control name, or add an open question documenting the public-doc silence so the guide can use a Dossier-backed console-label hedge.

blockers.where: Opening prose: “Sign in to the Developer Preview page with the Google Workspace account applying to the program.”

blockers.where: #configure-oauth-consent — “If Google Auth Platform is already configured, continue at Add the Google Sheets scopes.”
blockers.problem: Readers with an existing External OAuth configuration that remains in testing can skip adding the intended Google account as a test user, causing authorization to fail during first connection.
blockers.suggestion: Research and record how readers identify an existing External configuration that is still in testing, then add a conditional path that uses Audience > Test users > Add users before proceeding to the scopes.

blockers.suggestion: Place the **Add users**, email-entry, and **Save** actions together under the condition that **User type** is **External** and **Publishing status** is **Testing**; otherwise direct the reader to continue to the scopes.

blockers.where: #configure-oauth-consent — “If Google Auth Platform is already configured” steps 3–5

blockers.suggestion: Make entering the intended Google account and clicking Save substeps of the External-and-Testing condition, and explicitly tell all other readers to continue at Add the Google Sheets scopes.
